newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish August production rose in all sectors - SF.
newsitem.headline: Finnish August production rose in all sectors - SF.

text.p: Production increased in all sectors of the Finnish economy in August, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
Growth in gross domestic product (GDP) slowed to the level of early last summer, up 2.1 percent year-on-year after a 3.9 percent rise in July, it said earlier.
"Production increased in all sectors," it said.
In industry and construction, the year-on-year increase was two percent while transport sector growth was three percent. @
Trade ouput rose 1.5 percent year-on-year in August, and production of other services and the public sector grew two percent. The growth rate in farming was one percent, it said.
